category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be participating in a post-story Q&A team game in the classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our post-story Q&A game. Please sit with your team and look at the first question.

STUDENT: (Ignores the tutor and plays with a pencil) I don't care about the story. I hate English.

TUTOR: Try to focus on the game with your teammates.

STUDENT: (Starts tearing strips of paper instead of looking at the questions) No.

TUTOR: Please put the paper down and answer the question.

STUDENT: (Gets up and starts running around the room, trying to fight with another student) I'm not doing this!

options.A: Allow the student to work at their own pace and take breaks as wanted.
options.B: Use planned ignoring by stepping into an adjoining room during the student's outburst.
options.C: Put the student on the same team as their peers during the competitive game.
options.D: Avoid intervening too soon by allowing the student wait time during the game.
